ConnectionStrings._comment: PostgreSQL is the only supported provider. Left blank on purpose: the API refuses to start without it rather than falling back to a throwaway database. Set ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection as an environment variable on the server (systemd EnvironmentFile, see deploy/aadhi-api.env.example) and in appsettings.Development.json locally. Keyword form ('Host=...;Port=5432;Database=...;Username=...;Password=...') and URI form ('postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db') are both accepted.

JwtSettings._comment: SecretKey is a SECRET and is never committed. Set JwtSettings__SecretKey in the environment (minimum 32 characters). Rotating it invalidates every issued token, logging all users out.

Cors._comment: Semicolon- or comma-separated allowed origins; empty keeps allow-all (warned outside Development). Production (Cloudflare Pages): https://aadhicracker.in;https://www.aadhicracker.in;https://adminerp.aadhicracker.in

Seeding._comment: IncludeDemoData: true/false — demo products/customers/orders/promotions; empty defaults to true only in Development. Keep it false in production. AdminEmail/AdminPassword override the seeded admin account at creation time only (set Seeding__AdminPassword in the environment).

Storage._comment: Provider: 'R2' (Cloudflare R2) in every real environment, or 'Local' (wwwroot/storage) for offline development only. Credentials are NEVER committed: set Storage__Provider, Storage__R2__AccountId, Storage__R2__AccessKeyId, Storage__R2__SecretAccessKey, Storage__R2__BucketName and Storage__R2__PublicBaseUrl in the environment. When Provider=R2 and any R2 value is blank the API refuses to start and names the missing key — it will not quietly fall back to local disk. PublicBaseUrl is the origin objects are SERVED from (a custom domain, or the bucket's pub-<hash>.r2.dev URL), not the S3 API endpoint, which is derived from AccountId.
